bento.title: From operational friction to digital infrastructure

items.title: Is your growth creating administrative chaos?
items.desc: Scaling hurts without the right infrastructure. At DOT Solutions we don't just sell licenses; we design the digital architecture your business needs to bill more.

items.title: Say goodbye to disconnected spreadsheets — unify your data.
items.desc: Integrate accounting, CRM and warehouse in real time. If you sell on Retail Pro or eCommerce, SAP Business One discounts stock instantly. No human error.

items.title: Make decisions based on Profitability, not intuition.
items.desc: Financial dashboards with native BI (Business Intelligence). Know exactly which product, salesperson or branch is most profitable today, not at month's end.

items.desc: Cut manual operational load by up to 40%. Let your team focus on selling and building loyalty while SAP handles the data bureaucracy.
